validity.recommendation: Treat as unverified. Demote/merge unless Aramco/technical documentation naming this exact KP-943 Riyadh segment can be found; do not present as an independently confirmed standalone pipeline.
validity.researcher_notes: The row as a DISCRETE pipeline is not independently verifiable. gem.wiki (read for leads, not cited) has an EMPTY Location section, no route, no coordinates, no start year, no capacity — only Length 153 km, Diameter 48 in, Status operating, Owner/Operator Saudi Aramco. Its ONLY two references are generic OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins (ASB 2012 p.75; ASB2013 page 79). Those are country-level production/reserves tables and cannot name a cryptic engineering segment; ASB2013 page79 now returns HTTP 403 (url_verifier FAIL) and even if live would not support a 153 km/48-in segment. A targeted web search surfaces the name 'AY-1 KP 943-Riyadh' ONLY on gem.wiki and GEM mirrors — no independent source names it. The name itself is an Aramco internal kilometer-point (KP 943) segment label on the AY-1 (Abqaiq–Yanbu line 1) trunk; the whole P1897–P1925 block (all bulk-updated 2022-07-19 / 2023-09-01) reads as a one-time technical/GIS segment inventory rather than independently notable pipelines. Existence of the AY-1 CORRIDOR is real (see duplicate note) but the existence of THIS named 153 km Riyadh segment is unsupported.

validity.recommendation: Adjudicate as a KP-segment of the AY-1 / A47-Yanbu / East-West sales-gas trunk. Most likely a segment double-count of P1897 (A47-Yanbu Gas Pipeline); also the same physical east-west gas corridor as P3962 (East–West Gas Pipeline). Merge or fold into the parent line rather than carrying as a standalone row.
validity.researcher_notes: 'AY-1' = Abqaiq–Yanbu line 1, the Aramco East/West sales-gas trunk to Yanbu — confirmed by the DMS Universe project 'East/West Sales Gas to Yanbu through AY-1 Pipeline' (verified 200, tokens 'AY-1'+'Yanbu' present; operator Saudi Aramco). Web results also describe AY-1 as the 48-in Abqaiq–Yanbu line (paralleled by the 56-in AY-1L). This row's segment_name is literally 'Pump Station and A47/Yanbu', its diameter (48 in) matches the AY-1 line, and 'KP 943' is a kilometer point ON that trunk. That makes P1903 a KP-sliced segment of: (1) P1897 'A47-Yanbu Gas Pipeline' (966 km; diameters 42/48/56 — same A47/AY–Yanbu line, shares the 48-in size); and the same physical east-west gas corridor as (2) P3962 'East–West Gas Pipeline (Saudi Arabia) / Main Line' (Eastern Province→Yanbu, 1200 km, 48 in), which GulfPub records as 'East-West Gas Pipeline' Abqaiq/Shedgum→Yanbu. GulfPub's 20-feature Saudi gas roster (best independent Saudi coverage) contains NO 'AY-1 KP 943' or 153 km/48-in Riyadh spur — its only Riyadh gas lines are 'Riyadh - East/West Pipeline' (16 in, 41 km) and 'MGS Possible Expansion' (16 in), neither matching. Nearest parent to name: P1897.

routes.end_name: Yanbu al-Bahr, Red Sea coast (terminus of the AY-1 / East–West sales-gas trunk this segment belongs to)
routes.corridor_desc: Endpoints are only loosely bounded. The AY-1 (Abqaiq–Yanbu line 1) / East–West sales-gas trunk runs from the Eastern Province gas plants (Shedgum/Abqaiq/Uthmaniyah area, ~26.0N 49.7E) west-southwest across central Saudi Arabia, passing near Riyadh (~24.71N 46.68E), to Yanbu al-Bahr on the Red Sea (~24.09N 38.06E). This row is a kilometer-point ('KP 943') segment of that corridor with a Riyadh association; its precise start/end could NOT be located from independent sources (KP 943 is an internal Aramco chainage marker). Riyadh and Yanbu coordinates are real, well-known city/port centroids, not pipeline points. Bound is coarse (whole central-to-western corridor); do NOT treat as a metered route.
routes.researcher_notes: Only the AY-1→Yanbu direction is sourced (DMS Universe). Riyadh comes from the sheet's own start field; KP 943 is unlocatable without fabrication, so no waypoint coordinates are asserted. Coordinates given are defensible city/port centroids (Riyadh, Yanbu), never invented pipeline vertices. Suggested accuracy 'low' because only the broad corridor, not the segment, is defensible.

summary: P1903 is a concern (existence + duplicate): a cryptic KP-943 kilometer-point segment of the AY-1/A47-Yanbu/East-West sales-gas trunk with no independent naming (sole refs are generic OPEC bulletins); likely a segment double-count of P1897 (also same corridor as P3962).
